# HeaderAndFooterTemplate

## Simple JS Site | About
Source: https://derekverbrugge.github.io/HeaderAndFooterTemplate/about.html

About
How this site works
The header and footer are stored separately so they
don't have to be copied into every page.
The basic idea
Every page contains an empty element with the ID
site-header .
<div id="site-header"></div>
JavaScript finds that element and loads
header.html into it.
loadPartial("site-header", "header.html");
The footer works exactly the same way.
loadPartial("site-footer", "footer.html");

## Simple JS Site | Home
Source: https://derekverbrugge.github.io/HeaderAndFooterTemplate/

Simple JavaScript Demo
Build simple websites
without unnecessary complexity.
This website uses ordinary HTML, CSS, and a small
amount of JavaScript to create reusable headers
and footers.
Learn how it works
What makes this simple?
Plain HTML
Each page is ordinary HTML. There is no framework
and no special templating language.
Small JavaScript
JavaScript has one primary job: load reusable
pieces of HTML and add only the behavior we need.
Shared CSS
One stylesheet controls the appearance of every
page.
